EC1: Patients with a calculated PRA higher than 0% per solid phase and / or anti-HLA [OR] class I and / or class II antibodies detectable by single antigen test (Luminex®).
EC3: Patients who receive a graft from a cadaver donor.
EC5: Patients who have undergone a previous solid organ transplant (including kidney transplant) or who are going to receive another solid organ transplant concomitantly.
EC6: Glomerular primary focal [OR] and segmental sclerosis
EC7: Atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome (aHUS) [OR] / thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura syndrome.
EC8: Patients with chronic infection with Hepatitis B virus (HBV) [OR] and / or active infection with Hepatitis C virus (positive PCR result) at the time of transplant.
EC9: Patients with infection with the known Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV).
EC10: Patients with active systemic infection [AND] that requires the continued administration of antibiotics.
EC11: Patients with any neoplasm [AND] [NOT] except localized skin cancer and who is receiving adequate treatment.
EC12: Patients with severe anemia (hemoglobin <6g / dl) [OR], leukopenia  (WBC <2500 / mm3) [OR] and / or thrombocytopenia (platelets <80,000 / mm3).
EC13: Patients who are hemodynamically unstable even if they have hemoglobin levels> 6g / dL.
EC14: Patients with intestinal pathology [OR] or severe diarrhea that may decrease absorption according to medical criteria.
EC15: Patients with known hypersensitivity [AND] to any of the drugs used in this study.
EC16: Patients who have received any investigational drug in the 30 days prior to their inclusion in this study.
EC17: Potentially fertile women who do not agree to use reliable contraceptive measures during the trial, who are pregnant, breastfeeding or who present a positive pregnancy test at the time of their inclusion in the study.
EC18: Patients who are legally detained [AND] in an official institution.
